thesis: Competence may grow by learning both sufficient states and reusable operations with explicit validity contracts.
role: Specify the proposed architecture and its verification obligations.

ideas.statement: State compression retains relevant past; operation compression avoids repeated work, with transfer and total costs deciding whether library growth is progress.
Reusable operations need domain, semantics, fidelity, intermediate-output and resource contracts plus safe behavior outside their domain.
Provenance can make a library revisable when premises change, but its value must be measured on bounded tasks.

evidenceAndExamples.statement: Circuits expose dependencies and shared subcomputations; DreamCoder is a precedent for learning abstraction libraries.

objectionsAndQualifications.statement: AI proposal knowledge is an external resource; proofs of models and favorable real-world tests establish different guarantees.

audit.notes: Complete batch read; headings and navigation excluded from idea ranking.
